extraction: Deterministic excerpts from saved state; no new model call or visual judgment. Historical online findings are attributed, not instructions.
request: Transform the room into a futuristic space-station sports arena with metallic walls, blue-white lighting, and Earth visible through large windows. Dress the players in sleek sci-fi athletic suits and give the table glowing blue edges. Preserve faces, playing motions, ball trajectory, table geometry, and camera movement.

arguments.prompt: Transform this table-tennis room into a realistic futuristic space-station sports arena. Replace the room surfaces with brushed metallic wall panels, structural columns and a dark satin-metal sports floor, illuminated by integrated blue-white light strips. Convert the existing background window areas into large reinforced observation windows revealing a clearly recognizable blue Earth with white clouds against black space. Keep the room's perspective and layout consistent with the original camera. Dress both foreground players and the visible background player in sleek, flexible graphite sci-fi athletic suits with subtle silver panels and thin cyan accents, with fitted athletic shoes. Keep their heads uncovered and preserve their original faces, hairstyles, glasses, body proportions and identities. Add narrow luminous blue strips along the table's existing outer edges, with restrained glow that leaves the playing surface and ball clearly visible. Preserve the table's exact shape, dimensions, position, blue playing surface, markings, net and curved supporting-base geometry. Preserve the original rally frame by frame: the players' poses, footwork, arm movements, paddle swings, paddle shapes, white ball position and trajectory, and the timing of every action. Preserve the original framing, perspective and camera movement throughout. Keep all environmental and costume details stable over time, with realistic materials and natural facial skin tones under the cool arena lighting.

Apply a selective futuristic makeover to this original table-tennis footage. Preserve the photographed people and rally. Keep both players' original heads unchanged: identical faces, facial proportions, skin texture, hairlines and hairstyles. Retain the near-left player's short thinning hair and original profile, and the far-right player's straight short hair and rectangular eyeglasses throughout. Keep their natural appearances without beautification or recasting. Change their clothing below the neck into sleek, flexible graphite sci-fi athletic suits with subtle silver seams and thin blue accents, following the original clothing silhouettes and body proportions. Keep bare hands, fingers, paddle grips and red paddles distinct and faithful to the source during every swing. Preserve the single white ball at its original position in every frame, including its size, motion blur, flight path, paddle contacts and bounce timing, especially during the final outgoing flight. Preserve every stance, step, arm movement and final sideways lunge. Transform the room surfaces into a space-station sports arena with brushed metallic wall panels, blue-white architectural lighting and large observation windows showing Earth and stars. Keep the original room perspective, columns, background player and secondary tables in their existing locations. Use balanced lighting so the original faces remain clearly recognizable. Add a narrow glowing blue strip to the main tabletop's existing outer rim. Keep the original blue playing surface, white markings, net, tabletop thickness and exact geometry unchanged. Leave the original red curved arch supports intact, including their thin profiles, feet and open spaces beneath the table; add no undercarriage panels or new supports. Preserve the original framing and camera movement. Keep the environment, clothing and edge lighting consistent throughout.

The near-left man retains his original facial profile and very short thinning hair with receding temples. The far-right man retains his original rounded face, short straight forward fringe and rectangular eyeglasses. Keep their actual facial features, ages, expressions and hair silhouettes unchanged. Use natural skin tones and soft neutral-white illumination on their faces.

Large observation windows reveal a prominent blue Earth with recognizable white cloud systems and continents against black space; Earth occupies a substantial part of the window view. Retain the background player's location and the secondary tables.

Replace clothing below the neck with sleek graphite technical-fabric athletic suits, fitted along the original body silhouettes, with silver seams and restrained cyan accents. Preserve bare hands and the original red paddles. Add thin glowing blue strips along the existing tabletop perimeter. Retain the original blue tabletop, white lines, net, thickness, corners, red curved arch supports, feet and all open spaces beneath it, with exactly the source geometry.

Preserve the original action and camera movement: identical poses, footwork, swings, hand grips, paddle positions and final lateral lunge. Keep the single white ball in its source position at every corresponding frame, preserving its trajectory, motion blur, paddle contacts and bounce timing. Keep the photographic appearance and source framing. Establish the completed arena and costumes from the first frame, with clean solid structures and consistent details throughout; no opening transformation or dissolve.

findings.claim: Metallic wall panels, large windows showing Earth and stars, blue-white lighting, reflective sci-fi athletic suits, and glowing blue table edges clearly establish the requested setting.
findings.scope: whole frame

findings.claim: Both players have substantially redesigned facial features and sculpted, swept-up hairstyles. The near player's source hairline and profile are changed; the far player has a different facial shape and hairstyle, and his source glasses are absent. These are identity changes beyond the requested wardrobe transformation.
findings.scope: both players' heads

findings.claim: The rectangular tabletop, center markings, net, and broad perspective remain recognizable. The source's open red arch supports have been replaced with a bulkier dark undercarriage, broad solid panels, and different curved openings; this changes the table's geometry rather than simply adding illuminated edges.
findings.partial_boundary: The playing surface and net layout are broadly retained; support shapes, thicknesses, and openings are redesigned.
findings.scope: table and supports

findings.claim: The alternating stroke sequence, stance changes, and final far-player rightward lunge broadly correspond to the source. During several near-player strokes, however, the paddle and hand become indistinct or merge, reducing fidelity at the central playing action.
findings.partial_boundary: Broad body motion and rally event order survive; fine hand-and-paddle articulation is less faithful, and exact ball timing is separately imperfect.
findings.scope: both players and paddles

findings.claim: The final ball travels toward the far side and bounces in both videos, but its frame-by-frame position and bounce timing differ. The candidate ball advances ahead of the source during this flight and begins its rebound earlier: around 4.33 seconds it is already rising while the source ball is still approaching its lowest point. The final candidate ball is consequently visibly higher.
findings.partial_boundary: The broad flight direction and bounce event are retained; the exact trajectory and timing are not.
findings.scope: ball and table during final outgoing flight

findings.claim: The broad gradual framing movement corresponds to the source, with similar changes in the table's screen position and the final lunge remaining framed. No conspicuous independent camera jump appears. Initial framing is slightly different, and the candidate has a shorter image height, so exact pixel registration is not established.
findings.scope: whole frame; broad camera movement

findings.claim: Room panels, windows, Earth, table outline, glowing edges, and the redesigned supports remain generally coherent without conspicuous scene-wide jumps. Local hand-and-paddle definition deteriorates during some strokes. The bright ball also changes apparent size and elongation, although elongation alone can reflect motion blur.
findings.partial_boundary: The environment and large structures are stable; small fast-moving playing details are less consistent and readable.
findings.scope: whole frame, with local hand/paddle and ball limitations

gains: A clear, cohesive space-station setting with Earth visible through large windows.
Sleek athletic suits and luminous table edges integrated with the cool room lighting.
regressions: Both facial identities and hairstyles change, and the far player's glasses disappear.
Exact ball positions and final bounce timing drift; some near-player hand/paddle boundaries become indistinct.
retained: Alternating rally actions, stance changes, and final far-player lunge.
unknowns: Exact optical equivalence of camera movement.
Fine finger anatomy and precise paddle-ball contact at the available full-frame scale.

unresolved: Precise finger articulation and paddle-ball contact remain difficult to resolve at this image scale.
The visible defects do not establish their generation cause; execution provenance has not been examined.

findings.scope: windows and exterior view at sampled times

findings.claim: v2 restores clearly visible dark rectangular glasses on the far player, a meaningful improvement over their omission in v1. This restores an identifying accessory without resolving the changed face.

final.message: Selected v2 as the strongest available result. It delivers the futuristic arena, sci-fi suits, glowing blue table edges, and recognizable rally. Remaining defects include altered faces and table geometry, opening smearing, and subtle Earth visibility. Exact ball trajectory and camera matching remain unverified.
